AI_INPUT: Describe what you want to do…
AI_WELCOME_TITLE: What can I do for you?
AI_WELCOME: I can help you manage the panel, start and stop instances, and more.
AI_ENDPOINT_HELP: Full HTTP(S) URL including /chat/completions; supports compatible services and local models.
AI_KEY_HELP: Leave blank to keep the saved key. Local services may not require a key.
AI_INVALID_SETTINGS: Invalid AI settings. Check the URL, model and key.
AI_FORBIDDEN: Your current account is not allowed to perform this operation.
AI_INVALID_TOOL: Invalid tool arguments or unsupported settings.
AI_INVALID_MESSAGE: Send a non-empty message of up to 4,000 characters.
AI_BUSY: An AI request is already running or the service is busy. Try again later.
AI_EXPIRED: This conversation expired or is unavailable. Start a new chat.
AI_TOOL_LIMIT: This turn stopped after the same tool was requested 20 times. Review the results, then send a new message to continue.
AI_OPERATION_FAILED: The panel operation failed or its outcome is uncertain. Check the instance before retrying.
AI_PROVIDER_FAILED: The AI service failed, timed out or returned an invalid response. Check the endpoint, key, model and tool-call support. Completed operations are listed above.
AI_ACCOUNT_CHANGED: The account changed or you signed out. Reopen the assistant to start a new chat.
AI_REQUEST_FAILED: Could not connect to the AI plugin. Reopen the assistant to try again.
AI_CHECK_RESULT: The connection failed; some operations may have completed. Check the panel before sending the same instruction again.
AI_PERSONAL_HELP: Personal models are saved only for your account. All models retain your panel permissions.
AI_NO_MODELS: Add a personal model in the settings at the top right of the sidebar, or ask an administrator to add presets. Switching models starts a new chat.
AI_PRESETS_HELP: Add, edit or remove shared models, then save. Leave the key blank to keep the saved key for the same endpoint.
AI_MODEL_MISSING: The selected model is no longer available. Refresh the model list and select another.
AI_MODEL_LIMIT: You can save up to 20 personal models.
AI_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT: Regular users' personal models must use public HTTP(S) endpoints. Ask an administrator to add local models as presets.
AI_HISTORY_HELP: Your 50 most recent conversations. Conversations outside your current permission scope are hidden.
AI_HISTORY_READ_ONLY: The original model is unavailable or has changed. This conversation is read-only; start a new chat to continue.
AI_HISTORY_SAVE_FAILED: Conversation history could not be saved. Completed operations still apply; do not repeat them.
AI_FILE_READ_REQUIRED: Call read_file in this request before editing, and use its returned sha256.
AI_FILE_CHANGED: The file has changed. Read it again before editing.
AI_FILE_TEXT_ONLY: Only regular text files up to 64 KiB can be read or edited.
AI_DIFF_TRUNCATED: The diff is too large; this preview is truncated.
AI_CHAT_SETTINGS_HELP: These preferences apply only to your account and are saved for future use.
AI_SEND_ON_ENTER_HELP: When disabled, send with Ctrl+Enter or ⌘+Enter.
AI_MSL_UNSUPPORTED: This node does not support MSL installation. Update its instance plugin.
AI_TOOL_download_mod_batch: Download mods or plugins in a batch
AI_MOD_UNSUPPORTED: This node does not support mod download tasks. Enable and update its mod and runtime plugins.
AI_THINKING_ENABLED_HELP: Default sends no reasoning option. Enable sends the selected reasoning_effort; disable sends none. The service must support these values.
AI_THINKING_EFFORT_HELP: Applies when enabled. Higher effort may take longer; supported levels depend on the model.
AI_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Review this operation. It will run only after you approve it.
AI_APPROVAL_EXPIRED: This approval has expired or is unavailable. Check the latest chat status.
AI_QUESTION_EXPIRED: This question has expired or is unavailable. Check the latest chat status.
AI_OPERATION_DENIED: The user denied this operation. Nothing was executed. Do not retry or bypass this decision.
